verdict.rationale: Recurring scheduled jobs or workflows are a fair question for a business communications platform, so the axis applies. The evidence covers API access, MCP tools for one-off actions (sending texts, pulling history), call routing, and event-triggered webhooks, but nothing documents scheduling a recurring job or workflow. One-off actions and event triggers are not a recurring schedule.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can schedule recurring jobs or workflows
